Agentic Autonomy & Orchestration.blurb: Projects where software acts on your behalf: crews, watchers, gates, and the machinery that keeps autonomous behaviour governable.

Developer Tooling & Code Intelligence.blurb: Tools that change how software gets written, shipped, diagnosed, or repaired — including agents that edit real repositories.

Health, Care & Human Performance.blurb: Clinical, therapeutic, and bodily-self-tracking projects — where the cost of a wrong answer is paid by a human, not a server.

Climate, Energy & the Physical World.blurb: Sensing and acting on matter: grids, farms, fleets, sensors, robots, and anything with a physical consequence.

Public Trust, Safety & Compliance.blurb: Verification, provenance, moderation, forensics, and the paperwork of modern institutions rebuilt as machine-readable evidence.

Money, Commerce & Marketplaces.blurb: Transactions, matching, pricing, and the boring plumbing that makes an exchange actually settle.

Creative Media, Story & Play.blurb: Film, games, music, writing and interactive narrative — including the production machinery behind generated media.

Learning & Knowledge Systems.blurb: Teaching, studying, tutoring, and the organization of what a group knows — from personal notes to institutional wikis.

Accessibility & Assistive Tech.blurb: Projects that widen who can use software: vision, hearing, speech, literacy, motor access, and language barriers.

Data, Retrieval & Memory Infrastructure.blurb: The substrate layer: state that survives a session, storage with opinions, and the ledgers everything else argues from.

Emerging & Cross-Domain.blurb: Submissions whose own description is too thin to place. Browse them; do not trust the score.
